name: Domijong
description: Domijong is a western domino variant that uses four double-six sets to produce a large duplicated-tile supply. This entry models the core as a connecting domino game; the enlarged supply shifts strategy toward mobility and robust end control rather than precise unique-tile inference.

content.text: Domijong is a western domino variant that uses four double-six sets to produce a large duplicated-tile supply. This entry models the core as a connecting domino game; the enlarged supply shifts strategy toward mobility and robust end control rather than precise unique-tile inference.
Domijong is encountered as a modern large-supply domino format that combines multiple standard sets to support larger groups and longer sessions.
Four double-6 domino sets combined and mixed.
Domino sets and optional score tracking by table profile.
Deal tiles by player count; remaining tiles may form a boneyard by table profile.
